title: DOTr steps up clearing of footbridges leading to MRT, EDSA Busway

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon has ordered officials of the Department of Transportation (DOTr) to speed up the clearing of footbridges leading to Metro Rail Transit (MRT) and EDSA Busway stations to prevent obstructions from impeding the movement of commuters. In an interview, Dizon said he had instructed Senior Undersecretary (SUSec)Steve Pastor and incoming Assistant Secretary (ASec) Gabriel Go to expedite the clearing operations, particularly on footbridges leading to public transport stations. “I instructed SUSec Steve and, in coordination with our incoming ASec, to double-time the clearing works, especially on the footbridges that will go to our stations, Busway and MRT,” […]...
